method: Preserved app library, removed battery exemption, revoked POST_NOTIFICATIONS and cleared its permission flags, reset only setup_version to 2 and notification_permission_asked to false, then launched MainActivity. Inspected real system dialogs with UIAutomator, selected buttons by resource ID, and checked actual Android permission state with dumpsys.

allow.battery_prompt_text: Let app always run in background?

limitations: Manufacturer-specific battery settings and missing-intent fallback paths were not exercised on this emulator.
Battery exemption does not override Android Stop, Force stop or the media-processing foreground-service timeout.
Detector and checkpoint implementation were unchanged by this permission-setup update.
